items.question: Which tasks count as open for the digest?
items.ticket: Digest is skipped when nothing is open
items.chose: Includes only tasks whose status is exactly "open" and drops every other status (e.g. merged).
items.instead: Treat any status that is not closed or merged as open, for example in-review.

items.question: How is a task's age measured and rounded?
items.ticket: listing each open task with its age
items.chose: Age is whole 24-hour periods since postedAt, rounded down.
items.instead: Count calendar days in the organization's time zone, or round up.

items.question: What age does a task posted in the future get?
items.chose: Clamps the age to 0 instead of returning a negative number.
items.instead: Return the negative age, throw an error, or exclude the task.

items.question: Is a task stalled at exactly 14 days without a submission?
items.ticket: Tasks with no submissions for 14 days are flagged
items.chose: Flags the task when the gap is 14 days or more (>=).
items.instead: Flag only when the gap is strictly more than 14 days.

items.question: From when is the 14-day stall measured for a task with no submissions?
items.ticket: Tasks with no submissions for 14 days are flagged
items.chose: Measures from postedAt when there are no submissions.
items.instead: Never flag a task with no submissions, or flag it from the first digest.

items.question: For a task with several submissions, is the stall measured from the latest one?
items.ticket: Tasks with no submissions for 14 days are flagged
items.chose: Measures from the most recent submission time, so any submission in the last 14 days clears the flag.
items.instead: Measure from the first submission, or from the posting time.

items.question: What is the furthest gate when a task has no submissions?
items.instead: Use null or undefined, or a named "none" value.

items.question: How is the furthest gate computed across submissions?
items.chose: Takes the highest gate value over all submissions, whatever their order.
items.instead: Use the gate of the latest submission.

items.question: In what order are tasks listed in the digest?
items.chose: Stalled tasks first, then oldest posted first, then by id ascending.
items.instead: Keep the input order, or sort by age descending only.

items.question: What subject line does the digest have, and how does it handle singular counts?
items.chose: Uses "Weekly digest: N open tasks, M stalled" and always writes "tasks", even for 1.
items.instead: Use a different wording, or pluralize correctly ("1 open task").

items.question: Does buildDigest check the time zone when nothing is open?
items.chose: Validates the time zone first, so an unknown zone throws even when the digest would be null.
items.instead: Return null for no open tasks without checking the zone.

items.question: Does buildDigest check that today is Monday?
items.ticket: Send a Monday email listing each open task
items.chose: buildDigest does not check the weekday and builds on any day; only isDigestDue checks for Monday.
items.instead: Return null when the date is not a Monday in the zone.
